title: no select multiple
rule: Don’t use `<select multiple>` — keyboard/VoiceOver (Safari) cannot operate it. Use checkboxes for multi-pick.

citation.source: NL Design System — Iedereen kan invullen

pass_when: Multi-choice uses checkboxes, not native `<select multiple>`.
overview: Do not use native select multiple; use checkboxes for multi-pick.
apply_when: Offering a multi-select choice set in a form.
not_when: Not for single-select dropdowns that correctly use ordinary select.
agent_hint: Replace select multiple with checkboxes for accessible multi-choice.
description: Do not use native `<select multiple>`—keyboard and VoiceOver on Safari cannot operate it reliably. Use checkboxes for multi-pick instead so every person can select several options. Fail when native `<select multiple>` is the control for multi-choice. Prefer an explicit checkbox group whenever more than one option may be chosen. Apply when offering a multi-select choice set in a form.
do_not_claim: GOLD avoid-select-except-long-lists as this multi-select ban; NSW multi-select pattern as a winner.
